clips.title: The story
paras: In the Royal Quarter, Sylvanas Windrunner directs the Forsaken from her throne. Varimathras stands at her side, while Royal Dreadguards protect the seat of power beneath the Undercity.

The Royal Quarter, also called the Hall of the Dark Lady, is where the Forsaken make their military and political decisions. Sylvanas Windrunner holds court in its vast chamber beneath the Undercity, working for the survival of her free-willed undead and the destruction of the Scourge. Royal Dreadguards keep watch along the dais, protecting their queen from uninvited visitors and would-be assassins.

Varimathras, a nathrezim, stands beside Sylvanas in the heart of the Undercity. During the civil war in the ruins of Lordaeron, he sided with her to save his own life and pledged loyalty to her cause. From the Royal Quarter, he commands deathstalkers and coordinates defenses across the realm. His tactical skill serves the Forsaken, but his demonic nature makes many Horde allies wary of his true allegiance.
